literal: Friends' needs they will not fulfill; good they will not do; the good-foreheaded woman's desires as they follow.
translation: Those who conduct themselves exactly as their beautiful wives desire will neither fulfill the needs of their friends nor do any good deeds.
modern: தம் மனைவியின் விருப்பப்படி மட்டுமே நடப்பவர்கள், தம் நண்பர்களின் குறைகளைத் தீர்க்க மாட்டார்கள்; எந்த ஒரு நற்செயலையும் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns against blindly following a wife's dictates. The phrase 'நன்னுதலாள் பெட்டாங்கு ஒழுகுபவர்' refers to men who act only according to the desires of their beautiful wives. Because their focus is entirely consumed by her wishes, they neglect their broader social duties. Consequently, they fail to help their friends in times of need and are unable to perform virtuous deeds for the wider community.
